description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Charming 30A Home:* 3 Min Walk to the Beach* Stunning Community Pool (Seasonally Heated, March through mid-April)* 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Pet-friendly (additional $250 fee)* Prime Location in the Heart of Seagrove Beach – Walk or bike to shops, cafes, and restaurants* Only 2.2 Miles to Seaside; 3.8 Miles to The Big Chill on 30A* Stroll to Café Thirty-A, Brozinni's Pizzeria, or Hokulia Shave Ice* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef – Explore vibrant marine life (see details below)*Professionally Managed with 24/7 Guest Support* This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.Welcome to Sugar Sand Bungalow, a beautifully maintained two-story 3-bedroom, 3-bath home just a short 3-minute walk from the beach! Designed for comfort and relaxation, this spacious getaway is perfect for families or small groups looking to enjoy a memorable beach vacation. The well-appointed kitchen features everything you need to prepare delicious meals, while the inviting living spaces provide plenty of room to unwind after a day in the sun. Step outside onto the balcony to sip your morning coffee, enjoy the fresh coastal breeze, or relax in the evening after a day at the beach. The first floor features a comfortable guest bedroom with a king bed and futon, along with a full bathroom. Upstairs, the spacious master bedroom offers a queen bed, while the second guest bedroom also features a queen bed, with an additional bathroom for convenience. With its comfortable accommodations, thoughtful layout, and unbeatable proximity to the beach, Sugar Sand Bungalow is the perfect place to relax, reconnect, and enjoy everything the coast has to offer.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed + Futon2nd Floor: Master Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedArea AttractionsSeaside – Famous as the backdrop for The Truman Show, Seaside charms visitors with its unique architecture and vibrant coastal village feel. Enjoy the farmer’s market, boutique shopping, art galleries, theaters, and a variety of dining options. Outdoor enthusiasts can bike, kayak, fish, golf, hike, or even try paragliding—all within reach.30A Beaches – The 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach is renowned for its sugar-white sand and emerald waters. Whether you want to relax under the sun, explore hidden beach paths, or enjoy the local cuisine, 30A offers endless options for fun and relaxation.Sea Turtle Reef Snorkeling – Launched in 2017, this artificial reef is located just 783 feet from Grayton Beach State Park. The four snorkeling reefs, spanning 40 acres of permitted sea bottom, are teeming with marine life at depths of 12–19 feet. For safety, we recommend using a kayak, paddleboard, or flotation device when exploring the reef, as sea conditions can change quickly. Read less
